briefs.brief: Design the visual system for a personal brand site of a freelance software developer. The site is bilingual (Traditional Chinese and English) and its positioning is "can be verified": every claim links to a repository, a test result or a public record. Audience: hiring managers and technical leads. Deliver a tokens.json (light and dark modes, 4 to 6 named colors each, with contrast pairs) and a one-page type and layout spec.

Design the visual system for a documentation site of an on-premises RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) tool. Dark mode is the primary mode and light mode must still be complete. Readers are engineers who spend long sessions reading and scanning code samples and configuration tables. Deliver a tokens.json (light and dark modes, 4 to 6 named colors each, with contrast pairs) and a one-page type and layout spec.

Design the visual system for a landing page of a community event, written mainly in Traditional Chinese with some English terms and speaker names. The page shows a schedule, a speaker list and a sign-up button, and is read mostly on phones. Deliver a tokens.json (light and dark modes, 4 to 6 named colors each, with contrast pairs) and a one-page type and layout spec.
